text:
ajay singh: heads up — starting Mistral-1.2 onboarding. weights landed at s3://redwood-models/mistral/1.2/ -> shard-0000..0003.pt. tokenizer mapping has eos id mismatch (eos=2 in vocab, model expects 501). Seeing truncation on clinical prompts. Anyone seen similar?

sara kim: on it. can you paste tokenizer.json head?

ajay singh: pasted snippet: `{"eos_token_id":2, "bos_token_id":1}` but model expects eos 501. suspect our convert script didn't map special tokens when merging merges.txt. quick fix: run conversion with --preserve-specials false then remap.

leah wang: yikes. that explains short outputs. we should add an assert in onboard pipeline to compare tokenizer.eos vs model.config.eos_token_id.

mike rogers: agree. also related serving knobs: for chat workloads need continuous_batching.min_batch_size=2, max_batch_latency_ms=12, batch_size_limit=64. kv_cache_policy=sticky for multi-turn.

carla ng: FYI CI failing on quant test with this model: OOM on q8_0 compile step. lowering compile_parallelism=2 fixed locally.

ajay singh: quick config I'm proposing:
```yaml
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  min_batch_size: 2
  max_batch_latency_ms: 12
scheduler:
  max_concurrent_streams: 120
  compile_parallelism: 2
caching:
  kv_cache_policy: sticky
serve:
  max_input_tokens: 8192
  max_output_tokens: 2048
```
Will push as a PR.

sara kim: pls include tokenizer assertion in onbarder and a unit that fails if eos mismatch. also add a migration to remap old tokenizers.

infra-bot: lint-check: config yaml indent ok. Container image prow 1.4.3.

mike rogers: @ajay can you drop the PR link when ready? I'll do a quick perf smoke on a 2k context.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for cluster us-west-2 - canary id cny-20260312-7

leah wang: canary failed on 1/3 hosts — reproducible: model returns truncated response at ~220 tokens for prompts with '---'.

ajay singh: that's the eos mismatch. will reupload tokenizer and weights pointer. changing eos in tokenizer to 501 and pushing new shard manifest.

carla ng: noted. also please add a warning in console docs about models with alt special token numbering.

sara kim: CR ping @mike rogers @leah wang — PR 8345 added tokenizer check + config. small change.

mike rogers: reviewing now. left one nit on doc blurb. LGTM otherwise.

leah wang: ok to promote to canary again after PR merges. suggest adding a short eval harness: 50 chat examples, check no accidental truncation, 95% pass.

ajay singh: added eval harness to PR. results locally: 48/50 pass. failing cases are edge text with triple dash separators, will add normalization.

mike rogers: once green I'll run perf: baseline qps and p95 latency vs prod 13b. expecting ~5-8% perf delta.

carla ng: re: compile OOM — recording workaround in runbook: set COMPILE_PARALLELISM=2 and monitor GPU mem during build.

ajay singh: thanks all. timeline: aim to merge today, canary tonight, prod tomorrow morning if stable. will post PR and s3 manifest link.
